check.headline: This looks like a scam: it asks you to pay a personal UPI ID or phone number.

report_channel.name: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal / helpline 1930

flags.title: Asks you to pay a personal UPI ID or phone number
flags.why: A government office or power company collects money through its own official payment page, not to a person's UPI ID or mobile number.

source.name: Reserve Bank of India (RBI Kehta Hai)

flags.title: Asks you to call or WhatsApp a number that isn't an official line
flags.quote: To avoid disconnection, contact our Electricity Officer Mr. S. Verma directly on his mobile 98765 43210 (WhatsApp available). Do not visit the office as it is closed for system update.
flags.why: It claims to be an organisation but gives a personal mobile number, and threatens to cut off or block your service. That is how fake disconnection and KYC messages work.

flags.title: Gives you less than 3 days to act
flags.quote: Your electricity power will be disconnected TONIGHT at 9:30 PM from the electricity office if the bill is not updated immediately.
flags.why: Very short deadlines are meant to rush you. Genuine notices usually give you weeks.

flags.title: Contact details are not on the official list
flags.quote: To avoid disconnection, contact our Electricity Officer Mr. S. Verma directly on his mobile 98765 43210 (WhatsApp available). Do not visit the office as it is closed for system update.
flags.why: We only hold official contacts for a short list of agencies. That alone does not make it a scam.
